checks: Validation starts from original issue/publication/independent consumption receipts and exact expected source bindings.
Only original native target nodes are selected, with original admission, issue age and remaining-time checks.
Expected terminal price remains original; signed remaining distance alone is rebased using the actual available decision midpoint.
Explicit model pip and current instrument pip conversion retains both scales and price basis. No original residual probability or interval is presented as conditionally recalibrated.
Zero is an actual neutral candidate available for incumbent valuation, not a fabricated missing forecast.
Nonzero original target windows refuse under exact_only; explicit nominal_management_boundary carries original selection policy/window/end/is_exact without silently extending remaining time.
Quote evidence is explicitly projected, hash bound and excludes arbitrary raw quote payloads.
closed_findings: Candidate retains prepared scope instead of dropping engineering/current provenance.
Decision bid/ask reject binary floats and booleans; only exact text/integer endpoints are admitted.
limits: A pure function cannot itself authenticate external source bytes or asserted historical I/O clocks; the registered caller must bind actual observations.
A nominal management boundary is a separately declared approximation when the fitted target may select a later complete candle.
scope: Independent read-only adapter source review only. Contract reviewed separately by another agent; no independent test rerun or runtime operation.
